name: DA Form 1 – Development application details
to: Assessment manager (Council; EDQ for PDA sites)
when: Any development application: material change of use, reconfiguring a lot or operational work

name: DA Form 2 – Building work details
when: Building work assessable against the planning scheme, or that needs referral
lodge: Attach to DA Form 1 in Brisbane online lodgement

name: SARA referral (DA Form 1 Part 5 + SARA lodgement)
when: State referral triggers apply (state-controlled road, koala, vegetation, wetland, coastal)
lodge: MyDAS2 (SARA's online system), after the assessment manager confirms the application

name: PDA development application
when: Site is in a Priority Development Area
lodge: EDQ – follow the lodgement instructions in the form

name: Environmental authority application (ERA)
to: Department of the Environment, Tourism, Science and Innovation (DESI)
when: An environmentally relevant activity is proposed (e.g. large generators, fuel burning or chemical storage for a data centre or industry)

name: Water and sewer connection application
when: New lots, new dwellings or intensified use

name: Electricity connection application
when: New or upgraded supply; large loads (data centres) need an early enquiry
lodge: Energex large-customer connections (for data centres and other large loads)

name: QLeave levy (Portable long service leave)
when: Building or construction work at or above the QLeave levy threshold (check current value)
